subject: Executive clearance: Cardea - request to include premium onboarding + custom connector discount
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cardea - request for executive clearance on onboarding & connector pricing

Team —

Quick summary: Cardea (Sophie Marshall) is pushing to have premium onboarding and a custom connector included in year 1 without the standard professional services (one-time) fee. Their PO is ready and procurement needs final commercial confirmation to proceed.

What I'm asking for:
- One-time concession to include Premium Onboarding (8 weeks, white‑glove) at 0 USD charge for year 1, instead of the $60k PS line item.
- Discount of 15% off the custom connector engineering fees (originally $40k) — i.e., $34k.
- Short SLA tweak for guaranteed 99.5% p99 latency for the dedicated pool for the first 6 months (we would monitor and revert to standard SLA after that).

Why: Cardea is fast-moving, committed to a 3‑year contract, and expects to expand (they target 5 more product teams next year). Net ARR impact for Redwood is $480k ARR Year 1 after credits; concession is intended to remove procurement friction and land the committed contract.

Attached: SOW v3 (redlines included) and updated pricing workbook.

Please confirm whether you can sign off at the deal desk level or if this needs exec approval. If you need more margin detail I can attach cost build.

Thanks,
Grace
Account Executive — Enterprise Health
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Cardea_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW with redlines), Redwood_proposal_cardea.xlsx (pricing workbook)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cardea - request for executive clearance on onboarding & connector pricing

Grace —

Thanks for the summary. A few quick questions before I loop in finance/CEO:
- Confirm net ACV after concessions for Year 1 and Year 2 (please provide gross to net).
- Margin delta on the PS line assuming we book $0 for onboarding year 1 and 15% off connector. I want to see expected gross margin impact for first 12 months.
- Any regulatory/data residency asks that increase operational cost? (Cardea is HIPAA-adjacent; call this out explicitly.)

If those answers look acceptable I can approve an exception at deal desk up to 12% discount total. Anything beyond that needs CEO sign. From your note it sounds like total concession is ~12% of TCV, so likely within scope but I need the numbers.

Also: the SLA tweak — we can accept a temporary 99.5% p99 for 6 months provided they accept a rollback clause and monitoring-based remediation. Add explicit rollback language to the SOW.

Put the numbers in a single slide and send — I'll expedite once I see it.

-Rishi
VP, Sales Operations

FYI — forwarding the procurement thread from Cardea. Key lines below.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Sophie Marshall <sophie@cardeahealth.com>
To: procurement@cardeahealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 14:04:12 -0400
Subject: Redwood proposal - onboarding and connector

Team —

Redwood's standard approach asks us to pay a professional services fee for onboarding and custom connector work. Given the aggressive go-live schedule and our commitment to the 3-year term, we're requesting Redwood include premium onboarding as a non-billable line for year 1 and discount the connector fee. This is a gating item for our PO.

We prefer an embedded onboarding approach to reduce operational ramp time and will accept a performance-based clause for the SLA.

Sophie Marshall
VP Product, Cardea Health

----- End forwarded message -----

Dev note: No unusual data residency asks beyond standard PHI handling; they want the dedicated pool in us-east and encryption at rest with KMS (supported). Margin impact: PS revenue deferred ~$60k, connector discount $6k. Net ACV reduction Year1: ~$66k; TCV for 3 years still healthy. I attached a very small margin build in the workbook.

If Rishi approves, I recommend we:
- Approve the one-time onboarding concession year 1 (no change to renewal pricing)
- Approve 15% off connector (capped)
- Add rollback and monitoring clause for SLA
- Require Cardea to agree to a post-onboarding performance review and expansion commitments in the MSA appendix

Thanks,
Dev
Deal Desk Analyst

Attachments: Redwood_proposal_cardea.xlsx (pricing workbook)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cardea - request for executive clearance on onboarding & connector pricing

Team —

I reviewed the numbers. Given the 3-year commitment and expansion signals from the customer, I approve the concessions with the following conditions (deal must include these):
1) Concession limit: onboarding waived only for year 1; full PS pricing resumes at renewal.
2) Connector discount: 15% capped at $6k.
3) SLA change: temporary p99 99.5% for 6 months with automated rollback clause; monitoring dashboard to be shared weekly for first 90 days.
4) Post-onboarding performance review at 90 days tied to a defined expansion checkpoint (metrics: latency, error rate, user adoption).
5) Finance to record an internal one-time marketing/strategic credit to reflect the PS giveback for accounting.

Grace — you have my sign-off to proceed to procurement and counter the SOW with these edits. Please get a final acceptance email from Sophie and attach to the deal in HubSpot.

-Rishi
VP, Sales Operations
